title: Business calendar
purpose: See one calendar's weekly opening hours, holidays, the targets that count in it and its history, and reach the forms to change them.
summary: One business calendar: its weekly opening hours, its holidays, the service targets that count in it and the changes made to it. Only the admin role can open this page.

tasks.title: Add a holiday
steps: Select [[Add holiday]] in the Holidays panel.
Enter the date and name, then save.

tasks.title: Remove a holiday
steps: Select the Remove button on the holiday's row.
Give the reason and select [[Remove holiday]].

tasks.title: Change the opening hours
steps: Select [[Edit calendar]], change the hours for each day, give the reason and save.

tasks.title: See who changed what
steps: Scroll to the history at the bottom. It lists changes to the calendar and its holidays, oldest first.

good_to_know: A holiday closes the whole day. Clocks on this calendar do not run on it.
A calendar cannot be made inactive while active targets still count in it.
Removing a holiday does not move due times that were already worked out.
Hours and holidays are read in the laboratory's time zone.

items.label: Status, holidays and targets
items.description: The header shows Active or Inactive, the number of holidays and the number of targets counting in this calendar (active and inactive).

items.label: Edit calendar
items.description: Opens the calendar form with the current name, hours and Active setting.

items.label: Inactive notice
items.description: An inactive calendar shows a notice that it is not offered for new targets and that tickets already counting in it keep it.

sections.title: Weekly opening hours
paragraphs: Monday to Sunday, each with its intervals written as HH:MM-HH:MM, or Closed. These are local times of the laboratory. An overnight shift appears as two intervals, one ending at 24:00 and one starting at 00:00 the next day.

items.label: Add holiday
items.description: Opens the form to add a date and a name.

items.label: Date and Holiday
items.description: Each holiday's date, with the weekday, and its name. The list is in date order. No holidays explains that clocks on this calendar then run on every opening day.

items.label: Remove (holiday name)
items.description: Opens the removal form, which asks for a reason. The holiday is deleted, and the removal stays in the history.

sections.title: Targets counting in this calendar
paragraphs: A table of the service targets that use this calendar: Target (opens its edit form), First response, Resolution and Status. No targets use this calendar means no target counts its times here yet.

sections.title: History
paragraphs: Every audited change to the calendar (created, updated) and to its holidays (added, removed), with who, when and, where one was given, the reason. Earlier events are never changed.
